narrative:
## Handover Summary — Blended Workforce

People cost validated by role, entity and delivery site.

## Key Decisions
• 20 multi-skilled advisors moved from Kent and Bexley evenings to DWP mornings
• Virtual-agent containment target raised from 18% to 25% on the top 40 intents
• TOIL balances capped and system-tracked

## Recommendation for Consolidation
Test the containment ramp against KPI attainment before the board submission — every KPI point below target costs about GBP 4.6M of credits.
